summary: Both WP-007 files pass code review across all four dimensions.

error_handling.php: three-scenario structure (custom Error construction, Error 1001, Error 1002) is systematic and covers the full Error value-object API. Using setMaxFilesize(50) to trigger Error 1002 without a large fixture is elegant.
settings.php: cumulative state across sections correctly demonstrates Settings as a persistent store; the get() fallback demo with var_export makes the null-return contract explicit.

comments.note: error_handling.php: the @var Error|null annotation before the Settings::get('__error') cast is a small touch that greatly improves IDE type inference for consumers adapting this pattern. Good practice.

The error_handling.php example demonstrates it cleanly, but the data-flows doc currently omits this path entirely.
No observations requiring code changes — both files are exemplary in their clarity and scope management.
